name: Fetch public GenBank marker sequences for a taxon
description: Fetch at most 100 public non-TSA NCBI Nucleotide (GenBank) records of one marker gene for one taxon, with accession, isolate or strain, country and collection date. Sequences stay in the run record; the planner sees only summaries.
planner_guidance: Use fetch_markers when sequences of one marker are needed for a later step such as assign_ribotype; use taxon_inventory when counts are enough.
LSU is the marker that defines Margalefidinium polykrikoides ribotypes; ITS resolves some genera more finely.
Returned records are deposited sequences with submitter metadata; they do not establish presence or abundance at any site.

arguments.name: taxon
arguments.description: A numeric NCBI taxonomy ID, or a scientific name of one to three words starting with a capitalized genus.

arguments.name: marker
arguments.description: Marker gene matched by title keywords.

sources: NCBI Nucleotide (GenBank) through E-utilities ESearch, ESummary and EFetch

limitations: At most 100 records in ESearch order; the result says when more exist.
Marker selection matches title keywords; operon records spanning several markers are returned whole.
Isolate, location and date qualifiers are submitter metadata and are often missing.

policy_constraints.attribution: Cite GenBank accessions for any sequence used. NCBI disclaimer: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/About/disclaimer.html
